answer_2.quote: We introduced VLEU, a novel automatic metric to evaluate T2I models' generalizability. ... We also calculated Inception Score (IS), Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and CLIP scores.

answer_4.quote: We used these pairwise comparisons to compute an Elo rating for each model, where human evaluators compared pairs of images generated by randomly selected pairs of models, without knowing which model produced which image, and determine which image better adhered to the prompts.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators compared pairs of images generated by randomly selected models and determined which image better adhered to the prompts.
